name: manager_avatar
usage: Represents the player’s airport manager identity used for progression, upgrades, and interaction with business systems.
prompt: One isolated transparent-background sprite of a confident airport manager character, full body, facing slightly angled forward; wearing a crisp pilot-style suit with epaulets, tie, and headset, holding a tablet; clean silhouette, friendly expression; materials include fabric uniform and glossy tablet screen; color palette of navy blue, white, and gold accents; soft shading, mobile game readability; no background, no text, no watermark, centered, not cropped.

name: cash_bundle
usage: Displayed as a reward and currency pickup used by players to fund airport expansions and upgrades.
prompt: One isolated transparent-background sprite of a thick bundle of cash wrapped with a bank band; slightly angled perspective for depth; crisp rectangular silhouette with layered bills visible; materials show paper texture with subtle shading; bright green palette with light highlights; clean, bold shape for easy recognition; no background, no text, no watermark, centered, not cropped.

name: business_prop
usage: Placed within airport facilities to visually represent revenue-generating businesses and upgradeable services.
prompt: One isolated transparent-background sprite of a small airport shop kiosk, compact and modular; front-facing with slight angle; includes display counter, shelves with snacks and travel goods, small signage board shape (no text); materials include metal frame, glass display, and plastic panels; bright inviting colors like red, white, and blue; clean silhouette for mobile readability; no background, no text, no watermark, centered, not cropped.

name: profit_boost
usage: Used as a temporary power-up that increases income generation during active gameplay sessions.
prompt: One isolated transparent-background sprite of a glowing profit boost icon combining a stack of coins and an upward arrow; dynamic angled composition with spark effects; materials include shiny gold coins and neon arrow glow; vibrant gold and green palette; clear, bold silhouette with energy lines suggesting motion; no background, no text, no watermark, centered, not cropped.

name: starter_business
usage: Serves as the initial airport layout where players begin building and managing basic operations.
prompt: Opaque gameplay background of a small starter airport terminal; top-down or slightly angled view; includes check-in counters, seating area, small runway visible in distance; simple layout with clear walkable paths and open space for UI overlay; bright daytime lighting, welcoming mood; props include luggage carts, signs (no text), and basic shops; layered depth with foreground floor, midground counters, background runway; no logos or watermarks.

name: premium_business
usage: Represents an advanced airport environment unlocked later, supporting higher earnings and expanded operations.
prompt: Opaque gameplay background of a large premium airport terminal; wide angled view with multiple zones like luxury lounges, duty-free shops, and expanded gates; polished floors, glass walls, and modern architecture; clear gameplay layout with paths and open areas for placement; warm ambient lighting with highlights from interior fixtures; layered depth showing foreground seating, midground shops, and background aircraft windows; no text, no logos, no watermarks.
